scars.label: The Flat Failure

scars.description: ID specified 19mm pitch vs Silitek standard 19.05mm; accumulation across 85 keys threatened bezel alignment/yield [7, 10, 11].
scars.label: The Matrix War

scars.description: Vendor provided useless IGES wireframes derived from Catia; forced blind reconstruction of navigation surfaces [4, 12].
scars.label: Panasonic Data Void

quotes: Top surface entirely flat. Can you add curvature overall? [6]
The 3D file I received from Panasonic does not have much information. It is a wire frame file and does not show navigation keys. [4, 12]
Silitek's SK-7500 and SK-7510 has 19.05 mm pitch... We can design a keyboard in smaller pitch, ex. 19mm. [7]

forensic_summary.intervention: Norris (as Lincicum) executed a high-intensity 'Surgical CAD' sprint (100+ hours in <2 weeks) to re-loft the top surfaces, enforce a 7-11 degree IR tilt, and modify grip curvature while constraining internal geometry to standard low-cost key matrices.
forensic_summary.result: Delivered a manufacturable database that reconciled the 'Airboard' form factor with standard membrane switches, securing executive approval for the new model despite 'beating on extra CAD hours'.
forensic_summary.trigger: Vendor analysis (Silitek/Panasonic) revealed the ID intent was mechanically impossible—specifically, the rubber pad was 'too close to the edge' for PCB sealing and the key matrix pitch (19.05mm) clashed with the 2D layout. The initial hard model failed ergonomic validation (not level, too heavy).

toolchain: Vendors: Silitek (Key Matrix), Panasonic (RF/Mechanical Review), Sputnik Models (Hard Modeling), Lite-On

forensic_metrics.financial: Billed $24,900 in June 2000 for accelerated surface development rescue [1, 2]
forensic_metrics.governance: High-frequency iteration: Weekly status reports paired with bi-weekly invoicing and immediate CAD restructuring post-review [1]
forensic_metrics.process: Compressed 12-week surfacing cycle into 6-week sprint from broken wireframe to manufacturing release [3]

isomorphics.label: Tolerance Accumulation
